title: Meeting notes in your format
summary: Meeting notes now come out in your firm's own file note format. Upload one of your documents, or start from a built-in template.
body_markdown:
A first client conference and an internal strategy session shouldn’t produce the same notes. Now they don’t.


## Start from your own file note


Upload one of your firm’s file notes and Parachute turns it into a template. Notes generated from it keep its formatting, including tables, numbering, headers, footers and fonts. If a section wasn’t discussed, the note says so rather than filling the gap.


Built-in templates cover common client and internal meetings if you’d rather not upload your own.


## Pick once, or let Parachute pick


- Set a default for your firm, or choose **Auto** and Parachute picks the best fit from the transcript.
- Choose a different template for one meeting before it starts.
- Change the template after the meeting and the notes regenerate in the new format. Earlier versions are kept.


[Set up your templates](https://help.goparachute.ai/features/meeting-note-templates/)
